name: Nala
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow package-manager behavior: Nala rejects untrusted package URIs unless the explicit allow-unauthenticated configuration is enabled; package authentication is delegated to apt metadata/keyrings.
limitations: This application delegates payload verification to PackageKit/Flatpak/snapd/apt backends; the external backend version and active keyring are outside this checkout.
This evidence does not establish a complete primary self-updater classification.
